description:
Freedivers!! We are officially hearing your siren calls for a retreat filled with the ultimate blend of adventure, relaxation, and self-discovery! All on the enchanting island of Dominica, the “Nature Island of the Caribbean.”

Thanks to Just Get Wet and Blue Water Element, you will have 6 transformative days, you’ll explore the ocean’s depths right off a professional freediving platform, which is just a short swim off the beach. You will rejuvenate your body and mind with yoga and breathwork, and immerse yourself in one of the most biodiverse marine environments on Earth—home to majestic whales, vibrant coral reefs, and abundant marine life. The ocean is calling. Are you ready to answer?
what_is_included:
*Yoga, Breathwork, Meditation workshops, and freedive theory.&
*Daily freedive coaching
*Ocean Safari's with Sperm Whales and other pelagic marine life
*In water photography
*Lodging at Soufriere Guest house
